hooks.name: Pipeline regression
hooks.description: After Kiro edits a file under backend/app/pipeline/, run the pipeline tests.

action.prompt:
Pipeline regression hook. Apply ONLY if the file you just edited is under backend/app/pipeline/. Otherwise ignore this hook.

Run: cd backend && uv run pytest -q tests/test_pipeline*.py
Report any failures with the test name and a one-line cause.
